name: Randomised placebo-controlled senolytic trial with a functional primary endpoint

design.model: adults over 70 with reduced gait speed
design.readout: gait speed and six-minute walk at 6 and 12 months (primary); senescent markers in adipose biopsy (secondary); adverse events including delayed wound healing

discriminates: A functional benefit under blinding would move the whole senescence branch from marker to therapy; a null result with confirmed marker reduction would show that clearing senescent cells is not sufficient.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
